title: Elon Musk Is Putting On The Sheep Uniform Because The Wolves Are Starting to Get Canceled, Say Wack 100
htmlContent:
Elon Musk published and subsequently deleted a series of tweets expressing his support for Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, and his purchase of the right-wing social media app, Parler.

In the latest tweet, Musk posted portraits of himself, the rapper, and former president Donald Trump stacked on the incumbents of "The Three Musketeers."

In addition, at the end of each character's sword, the names of each of their respective social media societies are listed, from Parler to Truth Social and Musk's mysterious "X" platform.

The billionaire recently flip-flopped on his decision to buy Twitter, but he hinted he could either turn Twitter into an X or launch an entirely new platform.

"In retrospect, it was inevitable," Musk tweeted.

In a follow-up tweet, which was also deleted, Musk added: “Fun times ahead!!”

On Wednesday afternoon, Wack 100 was on Clubhouse and said Musk has to back off a little bit.

" He just went sheep. He just put the sheep uniform on because he was playing wolf with the Wolves, but he know if he doing that he see that a cancellation is starting to happening with the Wolves," said Wack.

"So, if they cancel these two wolves out and I'm visible right, they can cancel me out. So, let me go, sheep, so if they cancel my comrades out, I'm still in place. I'ma be real; n**** can say what they want about canceling a motherf****ers out. Can you imagine the thinking table, the resources, and the already accumulated money of Elon and Ye? The world of damn they have to end how you are going to you gonna stop it. "
